reviews.title: CORSAIR iCUE LINK LX120 RGB Expansion Fan
reviews.comment:
The CORSAIR iCUE LINK LX120 RGB Expansion Fan works perfectly as the rear exhaust in my PC. The CUE LINK system keeps the setup clean with minimal cabling, and the fan runs quietly while still pushing plenty of air. RGB lighting looks great and syncs flawlessly with the rest of the system through iCUE.
As an exhaust fan, it keeps temps stable during gaming and editing, and the overall build quality feels solid. A great addition to any iCUE LINK setup.
